title: FlightSearchResult
description: The 'result' payload shape when ProviderResponseEnvelope.capability='flight_search' (Checkpoint Phase 4 C.0, docs/adr/0009-phase4-checkpointc0-live-data-and-react-design.md). 'is_snapshot' is a structural const true -- it can never be false or omitted in a valid instance, so nothing downstream can accidentally treat a flight search result as bookable inventory. No booking, payment, reservation, or purchase contract is authorized by this schema or any consumer of it.

is_snapshot.description: Always true: a search-time snapshot of quoted offers, never a claim that a seat is available now, that a fare is guaranteed, or that anything is booked.

limitations.description: Explicit, human-readable limitations of this result (e.g. why it is empty, which constraints could not be honored). Always present, even when options is non-empty, if any limitation applies; an empty array means no known limitation.
